sources.name: PubChem
sources.notes: Use compound records as evidence for formula, charge, SMILES, Standard InChI/InChIKey and PubChem CID. Preserve record-level provenance; source-specific response shapes stay outside canonical records.

sources.name: ChEBI
sources.notes: Prefer curated 3-star records when available. ChEBI exposes formula, net charge, SMILES, InChI/InChIKey and stable CHEBI identifiers with traceable sources.

sources.name: RDKit
sources.notes: RDKit is a deterministic processing tool, not an authority source. Persist toolkit/version and derivation metadata; never persist RDKit Python/C++ objects as canonical dataset fields.
